item.title: Although I have update R to 4.5, Rstudio is still detecting the R version as 4.4.1. How do I change that?
item.description: Exactly the title. I am using some time series packages which need R version 4.4.3 and above, and so is my R version. But R-studio isnt able to see it and is unable to install those packages. Welp!!
